items.title: Higher direct images on a ringed site are the sheaf associated to the presheaf of cohomology of the inverse image
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-cohomology.tex (Cohomology on Sites)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file sites-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the higher direct images of a module on a ringed site with the sheafification of the presheaf V -> H^i(u(V), F) (statement lines 746-757). The argument is a two-step unfolding of definitions: an injective resolution F -> I^bullet turns R^i f_* F into the i-th cohomology sheaf of f_* I^bullet (proof lines 760-765), and the cohomology sheaf of a complex of O_D-modules is the sheaf associated to the presheaf of kernels modulo images (proof lines 766-774), whose sections are then rewritten as sections of I^bullet over u(V), giving H^i(u(V), F) (proof lines 775-780). The non-formal content is the recognition that the sheafification step is what makes the naive presheaf equal to the derived pushforward. The claim is H2: two definitions unfolded in the right order, no additional construction.
